contextReview.basis: Direct review: overcast daytime residential East Asian city lane with tiled shopfronts, a convenience store, potted plants, utility poles and overhead wires; dry asphalt, no rain depicted; humidity not inferred.

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The falling paper receipt is a scene prop. The ecru striped long sleeve shows at the hem and folded cuffs under the terracotta overshirt; the small hoops are warm gold-tone as in the actual image. Hidden backs and soles are inferred. Brand, metal, fibre composition and retail identity are unknown.

producerVisualReview.findings: All 27 isolated products have complete silhouettes, matching garment colors and visible details, clean alpha edges across four backgrounds, matching footwear/sock pairs, gold hoop pair and complete watch. No props or forced running trim. Look05 jeans retain visible rear construction; hidden garment fronts are conservative reconstructions. No visible matte, checkerboard or external shadow.

copy.titleEn: A STEP TOWARD THE FALLING PAPER

title.en: A step toward the falling paper

deck.en: Terracotta, fine stripes and a small warm gold accent.
deck.de: Terrakotta, feine Streifen und ein kleiner goldener Akzent.

intro.ko: 떨어지는 종이에 손을 뻗으며 오버셔츠가 열립니다.
intro.en: The overshirt opens as a hand reaches for a falling slip of paper.
intro.de: Das Overshirt öffnet sich beim Griff nach einem fallenden Zettel.

body.ko: 따뜻한 흙빛 셔츠 안에 에크루와 검정의 가는 가로줄을 두었습니다. 여유 있는 네이비 팬츠와 검정 더비는 색 많은 상체를 차분하게 받칩니다. 머리 옆의 작은 금빛 링이 셔츠의 온도를 반복하고, 플래시는 팔을 뻗는 순간의 옷 주름을 살립니다.
body.en: An ecru-and-black fine stripe sits inside the warm earth-red shirt. Relaxed navy trousers and black derbies steady the more colorful upper half. Small gold-tone hoops echo the shirt warmth, while flash picks out the folds made by the reaching arm.
body.de: Feine ecrufarbene und schwarze Querstreifen liegen unter dem warmen erdroten Hemd. Lockere marineblaue Hose und schwarze Derbys beruhigen die farbige obere Hälfte. Kleine goldfarbene Creolen greifen die Wärme des Hemdes auf. Blitz zeigt die Falten des ausgestreckten Arms.

tip.ko: 소매를 가볍게 접되 줄무늬 이너의 커프를 무리하게 당기지 마세요.
tip.en: Turn the shirt sleeves lightly without pulling the striped cuffs tight.
tip.de: Hemdärmel locker umschlagen, ohne die gestreiften Bündchen straff zu ziehen.

description.ko: 붉은 흙빛에 칼라와 밝은 단추, 패치 주머니가 있는 긴소매 셔츠.
description.en: Earth-red long-sleeve shirt with a collar, pale buttons and patch pockets.
description.de: Erdrotes Langarmhemd mit Kragen, hellen Knöpfen und aufgesetzten Taschen.

howToWear.ko: 앞을 열고 소매를 한 번 접어 줄무늬 이너를 드러내세요.
howToWear.en: Open the front and turn the sleeves once to show the stripes.
howToWear.de: Vorn offen tragen und die Ärmel einmal umschlagen, um Streifen zu zeigen.
